notes: One screen, drawn with spr_pp_font8 at 8 px a glyph: 32 characters a row and 30 rows. The font has one ink, so style is a role for a future second weight and never a colour today. Every text row is checked against the runtime glyph set from pp_font_glyphs() and against the row budget, because a row that runs past the frame cannot be seen and the sheet has no semicolon. The notices below are data that must travel inside the build, not screen text: data/ is mirrored into game/datafiles/, knowledge/ is not.

sources.holder: Copyright 2012 The Press Start 2P Project Authors (cody@zone38.net)
sources.note: Both URLs in this block belong to the licence document, not to the build. One is where the text was read from; the other is the address the OFL text itself names as its home, so it travels inside the quoted text in licences[0].text. The quoted text is data, copied once and stored at repo_path under the sha256 that entry declares. No GML file names this file, so no code can hand either string to a network call, and the build fetches nothing.
sources.serves: licences[0], the Press Start 2P licence text

sources.note: ODbL 1.0 obliges the copyright page address to appear in the attribution notice itself, so the same string is carried three times: as licences[1].required_line, as the place the notice was read from, and inside the notice text. Each copy is a credit line this licence requires the build to keep, not a callable address. The street geometry came from the Overpass download at data/maps/osm/southampton_town_quay.json, which records its own provenance.
